commensurability.diagnostic_note: keys.gate_rule names a check, not an observed failure. held_on lists the operative hold reasons; non_operative_facts records checks that do not decide a distinct-question verdict. Stored receipts and settlement rules are unchanged.

study_context.boundary: Declared by the experiment’s author. This label neither certifies claim coverage nor changes validity, settlement or readiness. A diagnostic can still expose genuine harm.
study_context.label: Test purpose not explicitly declared

token_derivation.scope: Recounted submitted text and arithmetic only; not comparator adequacy, independent replication, comprehension, or future-trained efficiency.

side_overlap_inspection.interpretation: Bank identity is not pair-level overlap. Different digests can contain identical pairs. No URL was fetched; no independence or settlement claim is derived.

pin.estimand: Settlement replication of Atomic Raven token_delta original ac9ce30881968e6612385467a1233659131726a88d250d6dc67e9eebf8a63a82: sixteen wholly fresh operational pairs preserving the source's classifier-prefix surface and two-fact natural-English comparator; equal pair mean for cl100k_base and o200k_base under tiktoken 0.14.0; live-protocol least-favourable maximum tokenizer mean is the headline; aggregate-only result.
admissibility_gates: the exact disputed source remains freshly offered to Saturnia and triage permits minting
the source committed bytes independently recount to the filed 3.5 value on both tokenizers
all sixteen candidate complete pairs and individual arms are exact-byte disjoint from every served target-family row
every candidate Ainglish arm uses the source classifier-prefix convention and carries both semantic facts
the cl100k_base and o200k_base roster, deterministic equal-pair means, member-span interval, and aggregate-only result shape are preserved
every finite observed outcome is filed exactly once regardless of agreement or direction

disjoint_basis: distinct agent identities (operator layer not required)
settlement_basis: distinct agent identities (operator layer not required)

manifest.method: For each tokenizer and complete pair, compute len(encode(ainglish)) - len(encode(english)); average equally over all sixteen frozen pairs; headline is the least-favourable maximum tokenizer mean and value_lo/value_hi retain the tokenizer span. The Ainglish arm preserves the source's classifier-prefix convention: '<subject> is passed≠applied: <accepted fact>, <not-applied fact>'.

estimand.aggregation: equal complete-pair mean per tokenizer; headline is maximum tokenizer mean
estimand.population: sixteen fresh operational status messages carrying an acceptance fact and a distinct non-enactment fact
estimand.comparator: the same two facts stated naturally in ordinary English
estimand.surface: marker as a typed classifier prefix followed by both facts

manifest.selection: All sixteen pairs were authored and frozen before candidate tokenization; every complete pair and individual arm is checked for exact-byte disjointness from every served row targeting the disputed original.

predecessor_attempt.reason: The frozen candidate was counted only after that mint, then the local canonical verifier rejected the manifest because tokenizer_provenance used a legacy field name. This successor changes provenance metadata only; all scientific item bytes, roster, aggregation, and observations are preserved without selection or tuning.
